title: Design brief - Government Primary School, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Block 7
summary: Two-storey RCC primary school for the School Education Department: twelve classrooms for about 480 pupils in two shifts, head teacher's office, staff room, library, science room, toilets with hand wash stations, assembly platform and play area.

format.lbo: Karachi Building and Town Planning Regulations 2002
format.energy: Building Code of Pakistan, Energy Provisions 2011

requirements.source_ref: Building Code of Pakistan, Seismic Provisions 2007

requirements.attribute: Separate blocks for girls and boys

programme.label: Covered area, ground and first floor
School site, 4 kanal
programme.basis: Site plan from the Education Works Department

topics.site_analysis: Plot inside Block 7 with access from the service road; the existing school next door stays open.
topics.supply: K-Electric connection with a 15 kW solar system for fans and lights, KWSC water with an underground tank and electric pump.
topics.building_structure: RCC frame with brick infill, RCC slabs, verandah corridors for cross ventilation.
topics.construction_method: Item rate contract with Karachi Builders, ready-mixed concrete from Korangi for slabs.
topics.commissioning_sequence: Water, electrical and solar tested before the furniture arrives; handover to the head teacher before the academic year.

studies.title: Site survey and soil report, Block 7
studies.scope: Topographic survey, three boreholes and sulphate content of the soil.
studies.author: Memon Structural Engineers
studies.result: Firm sandy silt below 1.5 m. Sulphate in the soil calls for sulphate-resisting cement below plinth.

studies.title: Natural ventilation and heat
studies.scope: Orientation, verandahs and roof insulation for Karachi summers.
studies.author: Clifton Design Associates
studies.result: North-facing classrooms with verandahs on the south keep the rooms under 34 C with fans.

issue_note: Design brief per the approved PC-I, issued for construction.
